# Messages

[English](messages.md) | [简体中文](../zh-CN/api-reference/messages.md)

[Back to the API Reference index](README.md)

Unified message sending and message actions.

## Operations on this page

- [`editMessage`](#edit-message): Edit message text
- [`pinMessage`](#pin-message): Pin or unpin a message
- [`reactMessage`](#react-message): Add or remove a message reaction
- [`revokeMessage`](#revoke-message): Revoke a message
- [`sendMessage`](#send-message): Send a message

## `editMessage`

Edit message text

Available only on supporting channels, usually for text messages.

| Property        | Value                                                                   |
| --------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| HTTP            | `POST` `/v1/messages/edit`                                              |
| SDK method      | `device.editMessage(request, execution?)`                               |
| SDK return type | `Promise<ApiResult<OperationData<DeviceApiOperations["editMessage"]>>>` |
| Authentication  | `X-Api-Key` (injected by the client)                                    |
| Mutability      | `write`                                                                 |
| Automatic retry | No automatic retries                                                    |

### Parameters

No path, query, header, or cookie parameters.

### Request body

JSON request body.

| Field                  | Required | Type     | Constraints | Description |
| ---------------------- | -------- | -------- | ----------- | ----------- |
| `body.account_id`      | Yes      | `string` | -           | -           |
| `body.conversation_id` | Yes      | `string` | -           | -           |
| `body.message_id`      | Yes      | `string` | -           | -           |
| `body.content`         | Yes      | `string` | -           | -           |

| `400`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The request body or parameters are invalid.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

| `409`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The request conflicts with the current state of the resource.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

| `502`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | Channel unavailable or invalid response. Protocol login restriction uses 30020: stop automatic retry and check the official WhatsApp app. WhatsApp disconnection uses 30021 across messages/contacts/groups: pause dependent requests, refresh runtime, restore connection and confirm running before resuming. ```ts

<a id="send-message"></a>

## `sendMessage`

Send a message

sticker sends WebP to WhatsApp user/group targets only, excluding whatsapp-protocol. Provide exactly one nonempty url/file_url/file_key; WhatsApp currently accepts HTTP(S) url/file_url only. file_key, nonempty mentions or unsupported targets return 501 unsupported_by_provider. Original WebP bytes are sent without transcoding; basic container integrity is checked, not channel rendering compatibility. Fetching is limited to 10 MiB, 15 seconds and three redirects. accepted does not guarantee delivery or animation. Other content fields are forbidden even when empty/null. provider_data must be omitted or {}; nonobjects return invalid_request and nonempty objects provider_invalid_request. Existing reply_to.reply_token is supported. Invalid material/source/size returns 400 provider_invalid_request / 36007 before sending; fix the material before resubmission. Actual channel rejection remains 30001. Fetch/storage/preparation failures return 500 send_message_failed / 36001. Unknown sticker outcomes are not retried; tracking IDs do not provide idempotency. poll creates WhatsApp user/group polls only. Require a nonblank question, at least two nonblank distinct original option titles and integer max_selections from 1 to the option count. WhatsApp policy limits question to 255 Unicode characters, options to 12 and titles to 100; these are not universal channel limits. reply_to/nonempty mentions are unsupported (501); invalid public structure/null/unknown/mixed fields return 400 invalid_request; channel field policy or provider_data.context_info/extra violations return provider_invalid_request. Optional returned reply_token can be used by ordinary text messages to reference the poll; do not substitute message_id/provider_ref. The poll itself cannot reply to another message; statistics and voting are not provided. Reconcile uncertain results before retrying. link_preview sends caller-supplied cards to WhatsApp user/group only. Require nonempty text and an HTTP(S) target; WhatsApp additionally requires title, image URL and the literal target URL in text. Title/description limits are 255/1024 Unicode characters. reply_to/nonempty mentions are unsupported (501); invalid structure returns invalid_request, while channel policy/card overrides return provider_invalid_request. The API does not scrape the target page. accepted proves neither delivery nor a self-sync callback. Stop automatic retries on WhatsApp platform restriction 30019, group-admin requirement 34012, or account restriction 20102; all retain HTTP 502 provider_unavailable. Verify permissions or resolve restrictions in the official app before resuming. whatsapp-protocol restriction uses 30020 and requires recovery/reauthorization. None proves permanent suspension or a recovery deadline. WhatsApp disconnected sends use 30021, not proof of logout; refresh runtime, restore connectivity and confirm running before sending. Failed requests are not automatically resent or reconnected. numeric_code 30010 may include an original reason; branch on codes, never mutable error text.

| Property        | Value                                                                   |
| --------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| HTTP            | `POST` `/v1/messages`                                                   |
| SDK method      | `device.sendMessage(request, execution?)`                               |
| SDK return type | `Promise<ApiResult<OperationData<DeviceApiOperations["sendMessage"]>>>` |
| Authentication  | `X-Api-Key` (injected by the client)                                    |
| Mutability      | `write`                                                                 |
| Automatic retry | No automatic retries                                                    |

### Parameters

No path, query, header, or cookie parameters.

### Request body

JSON request body.

| Field                       | Required                        | Type                             | Constraints                            | Description                                                                                                                                                    |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------- | -------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `body.account_id`           | Yes                             | `string`                         | minLength=1                            | -                                                                                                                                                              |
| `body.to`                   | Yes                             | `Recipient`                      | -                                      | -                                                                                                                                                              |
| `body.to.id`                | Yes                             | `string`                         | minLength=1                            | Channel recipient identifier.                                                                                                                                  |
| `body.to.type`              | Yes                             | `ConversationType`               | enum="user", "group", "channel"        | Standard conversation type; WhatsApp announcement groups remain group.                                                                                         |
| `body.message`              | Yes                             | `MessagePayload`                 | -                                      | -                                                                                                                                                              |
| `body.provider_data`        | No                              | `Record<string, unknown>`        | -                                      | -                                                                                                                                                              |
| `body.reply_to`             | No                              | `ReplyTo`                        | -                                      | -                                                                                                                                                              |
| `body.reply_to.reply_token` | Required when parent is present | `string`                         | minLength=1                            | Opaque reply handle from message.reply_token or send response data.reply_token, scoped to the original account/conversation. A message ID is not a substitute. |
| `body.mentions`             | No                              | `Array<Mention>`                 | -                                      | Group mentions. member uses the provider member ID; all mentions everyone only on supporting channels, otherwise unsupported_message_type.                     |
| `body.mentions[].type`      | No                              | `string enum("member" \| "all")` | enum="member", "all", default="member" | -                                                                                                                                                              |
| `body.mentions[].id`        | No                              | `string`                         | minLength=1                            | Provider member ID, required for type=member.                                                                                                                  |

### Responses

| HTTP status | Content-Type       | Schema                  | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ----------- | ------------------ | ----------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`       | `application/json` | `ResponseMeta & object` | The message send request has been accepted or completed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `400`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | Invalid body/parameters. Invalid sticker material returns provider_invalid_request / 36007 with a reason before sending.                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `401`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The API key is missing or cannot be validated.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `409`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The request conflicts with the current state of the resource.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `500`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | Message processing error. Sticker download/storage/preparation failures retain send_message_failed / 36001 with an available reason or default message.                                                                                                                                                   |
| `501`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The account's channel does not support this capability.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `502`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | Channel send failure. Do not automatically retry restrictions 20102 (WhatsApp account), 30020 (Protocol login), 30019 (platform) or 34012 (WhatsApp group admin required). Resolve permissions/restrictions first. 30021 means disconnected: refresh runtime first. 30010 may include an original reason. |

The SDK returns `ApiResult<T>` with `data`, `status`, an optional `requestId`, and the underlying `response`.

Success status `200` response fields:

| Field                           | Present | Type                | Constraints | Description                                                                                                                                                        |
| ------------------------------- | ------- | ------------------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `result.data.request_id`        | No      | `string`            | -           | The request ID generated by the server.                                                                                                                            |
| `result.data.client_request_id` | No      | `string`            | -           | Echoed when the client supplies a valid `X-Request-Id` request header.                                                                                             |
| `result.data.data`              | Yes     | `SendMessageResult` | -           | -                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `result.data.data.message_id`   | Yes     | `string`            | -           | -                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `result.data.data.account_id`   | Yes     | `string`            | -           | -                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `result.data.data.status`       | Yes     | `string`            | -           | -                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `result.data.data.provider_ref` | No      | `string`            | -           | -                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `result.data.data.reply_token`  | No      | `string`            | minLength=1 | Optional WhatsApp reply handle when complete context is available, including new polls that ordinary text may reference. Omission does not change accepted status. |

> This operation may return one-time or sensitive data. Handle it only in controlled locations and never log the full response.

### TypeScript example

```ts
const result = await device.sendMessage({
  body: {
    account_id: "acc_xxx",
    to: {
      id: "recipient_xxx",
      type: "user"
    },
    message: {
      type: "text",
      text: "Hello from UnifyPort"
    }
  }
});
console.log(result.status, result.requestId);
```

> Sensitive values in this example are placeholders. Read real values from a controlled runtime environment and never write them to logs.
